mapper.select: SELECT i.inbound_id, i.is_refund, i.request_date, s.inbound_status FROM inbound i INNER JOIN ( SELECT inbound_id, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN inbound_status = 'REQUEST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REQUEST' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN inbound_status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CONFIRMED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END AS inbound_status FROM inbound_detail WHERE approval_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY inbound_id ) s ON i.inbound_id = s.inbound_id where inbound_status='CONFIRMED' or inbound_status='REJECTED'

SELECT d.inbound_detail_id, l.lot_in_id, NVL(p.product_name, '없음') AS product_name, NVL(w.warehouse_name, '없음') AS warehouse_name, l.received_date, l.expiration_date, d.inbound_status, l.quantity FROM lot_in l JOIN inbound_detail d ON l.inbound_detail_id = d.inbound_detail_id LEFT JOIN product p ON d.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON l.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE d.inbound_id = #{value}

SELECT o.outbound_id, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN l.is_expired = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_expired, o.request_date, s.outbound_status FROM outbound o INNER JOIN ( SELECT outbound_id, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN outbound_status = 'REQUEST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REQUEST' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN outbound_status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CONFIRMED' ELSE 'REJECTED' END AS outbound_status FROM outbound_detail WHERE approval_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY outbound_id ) s ON o.outbound_id = s.outbound_id JOIN outbound_detail d ON d.outbound_id = o.outbound_id JOIN lot_out l ON l.outbound_detail_id = d.outbound_detail_id GROUP BY o.outbound_id, o.request_date, s.outbound_status

SELECT d.outbound_detail_id, l.lot_out_id, NVL(p.product_name, '없음') AS product_name, NVL(w.warehouse_name, '없음') AS warehouse_name, l.shipped_date, d.outbound_status, l.quantity FROM lot_out l JOIN outbound_detail d ON l.outbound_detail_id = d.outbound_detail_id LEFT JOIN product p ON d.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON l.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE d.outbound_id = 201
